directive.quote: finish the source-repo-a port so the repo can be retired and renamed source-repo-a-completely-ported

targets.baseline_commit_message: compare-voice-and-music-models: the narration voice A/B take makers, take measure and A/B render move byte for byte from source-repo-a

preserve: each unit is made N times; the take kept has the fewest whisper word errors against the unit's words, then the length nearest the median of the N
the clone takes the reference audio, and its exact words for an engine that wants them (qwen3)
the same units, pauses and inner-pause cap as the Kokoro take (kt.join, kt.trim)
the per-unit log (text, kept_errors, all_errors, seconds, heard) is printed and written to <take>.units.json
allowed_deltas: the reference is --ref or the settings' clone_reference instead of a narrator's file in the film folder
the engines, tries and whisper model are settings; whisper is mlx-whisper or the settings' whisper_here_dir
the generate-and-choose loop is say_units(line, generate, hear, ...), so it is tested with stand-in models
refusals before any model loads; a last {result}/{error} line
banned_substitutions: keeping the first take of each unit instead of the best of N
stretching a unit to a target length
_lines: The source is the file's lines named, in parts: the lines between them name the film's narrator and stay behind (their job is the line data and settings now).
